title: GradingTask
description: One thing to grade, as the API surfaces it: the authored triple (`GradingTaskCreate`) plus what the server assigned, and — the part that enforces reader independence — the CALLER'S OWN verdict and nothing else. `verdict` is the calling reader's row or null; it is null for an admin who is not a reader. `reader_verdicts` and `adjudication` are present ONLY for an admin and ONLY once the batch has left `open` (POST …/adjudicate): a reader never receives either field, whatever the batch status, and an admin never receives them while the read is still independent. A task the caller may not see — not a reader on its batch and not an admin — is a 404, indistinguishable from an unknown id (ADR-0003 §2).

id.description: Opaque server-assigned task id (a uuid4 hex).

batch_id.description: The batch (read) this task belongs to.

kind.description: Inherited from the batch. `evidence-read`: the R-dev / R-conf protocol (SPEC §6.6). `pointed-read`: r3 §11's pointed-question population, one extra question per pair. `citation-feedback`: a production user's judgement of an answer's citations (grading-ui.md phase 5; no batch of this kind is created in phase 1).

pair_id.description: The study's identifier for the pair, as authored; the export's `pair_id` column.

stratum.description: The sampling stratum, as authored. Absent when none was given.

claims.description: The claimed evidence sets, as authored (empty for a model-negative pair).

readers.description: The resolved subjects who may grade this task — the batch's `readers`, denormalised, in label order (index 0 is reader A).

created_by.description: Subject of the admin who created the batch.

verdict.description: The CALLER'S OWN verdict row, or null when the caller has not saved one (or is not a reader). Never another reader's.

reader_verdicts.description: Every reader's current verdict row, in label order, omitting readers who have not saved one. Present ONLY for an admin caller on a batch whose status is not `open`; absent otherwise.

adjudication.description: The joint-read verdict, or null when none has been saved. Present ONLY for an admin caller on a batch whose status is not `open`; absent otherwise.
